creative_extensions.claim_text: PESI incurred a net loss from continuing operations of approximately $19,569,000 in 2024 on revenue of $59,117,000 (down 34.1% YoY), recorded a full valuation allowance against deferred tax assets, an
creative_extensions.source_label: PESI claim_evolution self-disclosure tracking on liquidity covenant and FCCR amendments
creative_extensions.endpoint_or_method: claim_evolution.query_claim_evolution(cik='0000891532', search_term='FCCR', base_filing_date='2025-03-13', cutoff_date='2025-05-15') and similarly for 'going concern', 'covenant'
creative_extensions.rationale: The 10-K narrates 3 successive PNC credit-facility amendments (May 2024, Nov 2024, Mar 2025) that progressively LOOSENED covenants — a textbook distress-cluster fingerprint per H10. Tracking subsequent 8-K cadence on covenant amendments is the most direct trajectory signal.
creative_extensions.expected_observable: Subsequent 8-Ks on or before cutoff disclosing further covenant relief / waivers OR conversely, evidence that the company started meeting the FCCR on a trailing-twelve-month basis.
creative_extensions.signal_direction: Further amendments / waivers = distress reaffirmed; clean covenant compliance = distress receding.

creative_extensions.claim_text: PESI incurred a net loss from continuing operations of approximately $19,569,000 in 2024 on revenue of $59,117,000 (down 34.1% YoY), recorded a full valuation allowance against deferred tax assets, an
creative_extensions.source_label: Going-concern fingerprint cluster check against H10
creative_extensions.endpoint_or_method: Manual enumeration of cluster markers within ~6 months prior to cutoff: revenue down 34% YoY, two equity raises (May + Dec 2024), 3 successive credit-facility amendments (May 2024 / Nov 2024 / Mar 2025), full DTA valuation allowance, gross profit collapse to $2K (essentially zero), shareholder demand letter (Feb 2025), securities-class-action-style breach-of-fiduciary-duty complaint (Nov 2024 O'Neill).
creative_extensions.rationale: H10 requires >=2-3 markers within 6 months; PESI shows 5+. However, none of the markers is the classic going-concern qualifier OR a reverse stock split, and the company has $28.975M cash on hand and zero revolver draw. The cluster is real but pattern is 'distress-funded-through-capital-markets' not 'distress-with-no-exit'.
creative_extensions.expected_observable: Count of distress markers + auditor going-concern opinion / not.
creative_extensions.signal_direction: Marker count + auditor opinion calibration. PESI auditor (Grant Thornton) did not issue a going-concern qualification per the 10-K text.
